domain: Current saved Wishlist and disposable Store cache

user_wishlist.role: Current account-saved Steam AppIDs, independent of catalogue/Library ownership.
user_wishlist.summary: Preserve account, raw AppID, original source and exact added_at. Unavailable/unreleased games remain saved without synthetic catalogue rows.

user_id.note: Resolve the source owner through the same-run account map; account deletion cascades.

steam_appid.note: Exact unsigned Steam AppID, no catalogue foreign key or fabricated identity.

source.note: Original local/steam provenance, immutable on duplicate import.

added_at.note: Original UTC instant with exact microseconds, immutable on duplicate import.

wishlist_store_cache.role: Disposable country-specific Steam Store response and refresh lease.
wishlist_store_cache.summary: Rebuild from Steam Store under current country-aware runtime rules; no authored account facts. Do not copy old cache payload, expiry or lease.

steam_appid.recoverable_from: Steam Store fetch for the saved AppID and country; runtime cache/lease is rebuilt, not resumed.
steam_appid.note: Disposable provider cache or scheduling state, not authored Wishlist membership.
